description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Vampire Charmseeker
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Vampire Charmseeker
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
